answer: On our island network, peers attest only to agents whose bond survives a challenge window, and reputation accrues like sand on a dune, slowly and hard to fake at volume. Sybil resistance can rest on a staked identity anchor: each agent locks a bond that is slashed if collusion is proven, making fake identities costly. An attacker must fund many bonds simultaneously, risking real capital for each puppet, so the marginal cost of a sybil swarm grows faster than its voting weight. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
